personality.description: This person tends to seek out new ideas, experiment with different approaches, and stay mentally engaged by exploring unfamiliar perspectives. They usually keep their affairs reasonably in order while still leaving room to adapt when circumstances change, and they bring a lot of energy to social situations. When faced with moral dilemmas, they remain calm and reflective, weigh multiple viewpoints, and aim for a fair solution while still standing up for what they believe is right. In group discussions, they speak readily, contribute ideas freely, and help keep the conversation lively, but they can also be direct and firm when a point matters to them.
